metaDescription: Basset Hound vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Basset Hound boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Basset Hound social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Basset Hound exposure.
Weight range 40-65 lb (18-29 kg) and grooming needs (Long ears need cleaning; nails grow fast.) belong in the same Basset Hound household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.

If your Basset Hound is also monitored for intervertebral disc disease (ivdd) risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Basset Hound appointments.
After the Basset Hound puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Basset Hound misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Basset Hound series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Basset Hound is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Basset Hound away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Basset Hound due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Basset Hound core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Basset Hound misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Basset Hound health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Basset Hound adult health guide for breed predispositions such as ear infections, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
